context_for_next_testing_agent: CI config fixes verified locally on filesystem + pip install in fresh venv. The actual GitHub Actions run cannot be triggered from here, but all locally-verifiable invariants pass. If future failures arise on GitHub Actions specifically, check (a) that the GitHub runner can reach https://d33sy5i8bnduwe.cloudfront.net (egress allowlist), and (b) that the commit pushing yarn.lock has actually been merged to the branch CI is running on.
rca of the issue: Issue 1: emergentintegrations is hosted on Emergent's private CloudFront PyPI mirror, not public PyPI. pip default index search couldn't find it, hence 'No matching distribution found'. Fix: added --extra-index-url as first line of requirements.txt so pip appends Emergent's index to its search path. Issue 2: frontend/yarn.lock was previously untracked (likely gitignored or never staged), so a fresh CI checkout produced an empty frontend/ dir w.r.t. lockfile and setup-node's cache-dependency-path resolution failed. Fix: git add frontend/yarn.lock + bumped Node 20→24 since Node 20 is deprecated on GitHub Actions runners as of 2026.
